guard/30432.htm.text: Sentry Irene: I am Sentry Irene, who watches the Neutral Zone. The Neutral Zone begins just across this bridge.

guard/30432-1.htm.text: Sentry Irene: As damages mounted through continuous war between the Dark Elves and the Elves, we decided to swear to a cease-fire.
